column6: rewrites IF/ELSE/ENDIF into straight-line code: two condition temps (MOV and NOT of the IF condition, condComponent) are made before the IF; every register read or written in a branch is mapped (HashTable original -> temp, and back) to a fresh temp, KIL inside a branch is ANDed with the condition, each mapped temp is initialised from its original at the start of the branch, and after ENDIF every register written by either branch is merged back with a CMP (condition, if value, else value); finally the IF/ELSE/ENDIF operations are removed
